sources.summary: Scavenging and squabbling in Apocalypse. Plus: Fatiha El-Ghorri and Lucy Beaumont on The Great Celebrity Pottery Throw Down. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Channel 4 Survivor meets The Last of Us in this chilling reality show which dumps two teams of ordinary people in a real ghost town. The groups scavenge for food, find shelter and ultimately aim to survive – but at first they are unaware of each other’s existence. As with all juicy social experiments, the real entertainment starts as dynamics between such different characters begin to form and squabbles erupt into arguments (see jovial content creator Steven and alpha beef farmer Scott). From stealing chickens to pooing in a shared bucket, taking charge of food rationing and – perhaps worst of all – snoring, it’s not long before people turn on each other. How badly can things end for them? Hollie Richardson Continue reading...
